title: BIOS/GPT partition layout example
summary: Partition layout for BIOS systems using GPT, requiring a BIOS boot partition.

steps.explain: Create a BIOS boot partition of 1 MiB. This is required for GRUB or Limine to boot from GPT on BIOS systems.
Create a swap partition of at least 4 GiB (or RAM size for hibernation).
Create a root partition (/) using the remaining space (at least 23-32 GiB).
